Coronavirus Update

What if | want to cancel my test
even though it is scheduled to still
go ahead?

Customer Service 16 July 2020 18:23

If you do not want to take an upcoming test
due to Covid-19 concerns, we will defer you
to one of the next two available test
administrations, depending on capacity.
Please note this is a temporary policy
change due to the uncertainty and disruption
caused by Covid-19 worldwide.
